| affiliation = [[Outriggers]], [[Proudmoore Admiralty]], [[House Proudmoore]], [[Kul Tiras (kingdom)|Kul Tiras]], [[Alliance]], [[Irontide Raiders]], [[House Ashvane]] | loc = Central & southeastern [[Kul Tiras]] | territory = Contested }} '''Tiragarde Sound''' is the largest and most central of the three major [[Zone|regions]] of [[Kul Tiras]]. Mountainous and rugged, the region is divided in two by a massive bay that opens into the [[Great Sea]]. Tiragarde Sound is host to the Kul Tiran [[capital city]] of [[Boralus]] and thus serves as the seat of power for the ruling [[House Proudmoore]]. Its citizens retain a strong maritime tradition and hail from a wide range of backgrounds, from [[Outriggers|monster hunters]] and [[pirate]]s to nobles and [[tidesage]]s. ==History== The region is the ancestral home of the [[House Proudmoore|Proudmoores]]. The people of Tiragarde Sound are renowned monster hunters, raging battle against the creatures of the sea, and struggle every day against pirates at their own shores. While the pirates were once content to stay at [[Freehold]], in recent months, they have grown bolder, and began attacking Tiragarde Sound. The region has been marred by infighting and corruption. Gangs run rampant while the region's noble leaders squabble for power and influence.2018-08-01, [https://worldofwarcraft.com/en-us/news/21952595/battle-for-azeroth-tiragarde-sound-visitor-s-guide Battle for Azeroth: Tiragarde Sound Visitor's Guide]. ''Blizzard Entertainment'', retrieved on 2018-08-17 During the [[Fourth War|war]] between the [[Alliance]] and [[Horde]], the area served as the Alliance's staging point and home base.2017-11-03, [http://warcraft.blizzpro.com/2017/11/03/wow-battle-for-azeroth-new-continents-zones-blizzcon-2017/ WOW: BATTLE FOR AZEROTH NEW CONTINENTS, ZONES, BLIZZCON 2017]. ''Blizzpro'', retrieved on 2017-04-11 ==Getting there== ''[[The Relentless]]'', a ship captained by the veteran Kul Tiran seaman [[Cyrus Crestfall]], serves to transport members of the Alliance from [[Stormwind Harbor]] to the docks of [[Boralus]], on the eastern shore of the Sound. Additionally, there is a portal to Boralus in the [[Wizard's Sanctum]]. Requiring greater subtlety due to the ongoing conflict between the Alliance and [[Horde]], members of the latter are able to access the region through the ''[[Banshee's Wail]]''. ==Geography== The region of Tiragarde Sound serves as the heart of Kul Tiras. Nearly bisected by the capital city of [[Boralus]], the land is rich with wildlife in the hills and mountains to the north and south, and its people enjoy the bounty of the oceans to the south, east, and west. It is a realm of people in touch with both the land and the sea. Inland, the mountains and forests provide prime hunting grounds. A vast coastline borders Tiragarde Sound to the south, west, and east, where those brave enough can fish, boat, swim, and hunt for treasure. Tiragarde Sound sits on an inlet in the middle of Kul Tiras. It connects the [[Great Sea]] from one side of the island to the other, and is a connection point for all the major regions of Kul Tiras.2017-11-04, [http://warcraft.blizzplanet.com/blog/comments/blizzcon-2017-world-warcraft-battle-azeroth-panel-transcript/2 BlizzCon 2017 World of Warcraft: Battle for Azeroth Panel Transcript]. As the seat of the [[Proudmoore Admiralty]], they are also heavily present in the armies and fleets of the kingdom. *One of the ships of the [[Lost Fleet|Third Fleet]] was the ''[[Pride of Tiragarde]]''. *The [[Sailing Wolves]] are a [[bandit]] group operating in Tiragarde Sound. *[[Pirate]]s tell tales of a skeletal demon that lives in the sound. [[Flynn Fairwind]] believes that the [[krolusk]] known as the [[Ghost of the Deep]] is the origin of the story.[[Ghost of the Deep (quest)]] *In geography, a sound is a large sea or ocean inlet larger than a bay, deeper than a bight, and wider than a fjord; or a narrow sea or ocean channel between two bodies of land. *In the Map and Quest log the Tol Dagor instance is shown as part of Tiragarde Sound while the Tol Dagor outside zone is shown as a separate zone of Kul Tiras. ==Speculation== {{Speculation}} [[Tiragarde Keep]] is presumably named after the region.
